```rust
#![allow(clippy::all, dead_code, non_snake_case, unreachable_patterns, unsafe_op_in_unsafe_fn, unused, unused_imports, unused_mut)]
use anyhow::*;
use std::string::{String, ToString};
use std::vec::Vec;
use std::boxed::Box;
use std::format;
use std::error::Error as StdError;

#[test]
fn test_anyhow_error_creation_and_display() {
    let err = anyhow!("failure");
    let s = format!("{}", err);
    assert_eq!(s, "failure");
}

#[test]
fn test_error_can_be_moved_across_threads() {
    // Moving Error across a thread requires Error::Send + Sync,
    // which in turn requires the Backtrace type used internally to be
    // Send + Sync – the property asserted by _assert_send_sync().
    let err = anyhow!("send sync");
    let handle = std::thread::spawn(move || {
        format!("{}", err)
    });
    let s = handle.join().expect("thread panicked");
    assert_eq!(s, "send sync");
}

#[test]
fn test_error_downcast_preserves_source() {
    let io_err = std::io::Error::new(std::io::ErrorKind::Other, "io");
    let err = Error::from(io_err);
    assert!(err.is::<std::io::Error>());
    let down = err.downcast_ref::<std::io::Error>();
    assert!(down.is_some());
    let msg = format!("{}", down.unwrap());
    assert_eq!(msg, "io");
}
```
